description: Explains the Softwear Prints online shop plans (free, Professional, Enterprise) with prices and returns a link to set up an own shop on softwear-prints.com (staff shop, club or team shop, school, merchandise or event shop), prefilled with the organisation name and type. The user completes the setup and the account on the website; this tool sends nothing.

billing.description: Billing period to preselect for paid plans.

organisation.description: Name of the shop or organisation, used to prefill the shop name. Optional.

organisation_type.description: Kind of organisation, used to prefill the setup: company, staff_shop, club, fire_brigade, school, university, public_authority, brand, artist, merchandise or region_tourism. Optional.

plan.description: Plan to preselect. Without it the setup starts with the free plan; the user can change it there.

name: start_own_shop
title: Start your own shop
